text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Should today's lunch be Japanese or 
Western...? Whatever Lord Coin 
commands...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Whoops! Shoot... where did that coin 
go?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... And that one was the most balanced 
and easiest to toss, too...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It rolled over that way... so under the 
bed? ...Damn it, do I have to move it...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa flipped over furniture 
searching for coins and ended up 
completely exhausted.
